answer: Nets are mended from the centre, because a tear at the edge can wait but a tear in the middle loses fish. Tar straw rope layer jute licence covers the mending: a licence straw rope layers renew after laying yard reviews. The umber is the first tear mended, the whisper the last before the net is hung, and the atlas is the hanging, the net drying on the rack. Faking the mending takes 29 false tears and 29 false hangings.
